description:
We’re students with hands-on experience in deep research, AI-assisted coding, software engineering, web development, and graphic design. With Apex Fire, we’re exploring how data and technology can make wildfire monitoring more accessible and understandable.

Join us if you enjoy researching deeply, experimenting, and building things that matter. We’re looking for teammates interested in data analysis, mapping/GIS, backend development, or environmental science—and curious, motivated people.
